notes.title: First Playtest Weekend!
notes.content:
Welcome Everyone!

This is the first playtest for Collateral Dungeon using Steam!

The goals for this playtest are:
[list]
[*] Test on as many machines as possible
[*] Feedback on the main game loop
[/list]

If you are open to it, please use the QR code to send me feedback on your experience. Thanks for helping test the game!
